title: Learning to Retrieve and Reason on Knowledge Graph through Active Self-Reflection
abstract: arXiv:2502.14932v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Extensive research has investigated the integration of large language models (LLMs) with knowledge graphs to enhance the reasoning process. However, understanding how models perform reasoning utilizing structured graph knowledge remains underexplored. Most existing approaches rely on LLMs or retrievers to make binary judgments regarding the utilization of knowledge, which is too coarse. Meanwhile, there is still a lack of feedback mechanisms for reflection and control throughout the entire reasoning path. This paper proposes an Active self-Reflection framework for knowledge Graph reasoning (ArG), introducing for the first time an end-to-end training approach to achieve iterative reasoning grounded on structured graphs. Within the framework, the model leverages special tokens to actively control the reasoning process, achieving on-demand retrieval and multi-dimensional, finer-grained knowledge evaluation. translated_title: 通过主动自我反思学习在知识图谱上进行检索与推理
translated_abstract: 大量研究已经探索了将大语言模型（LLM）与知识图谱相结合以增强推理过程的方法。然而，对于模型如何利用结构化图知识进行推理，这一问题的理解仍然不够深入。大多数现有方法依赖LLM或检索器对知识的利用做出二元判断，这种方式过于粗糙。同时，在整个推理路径中仍然缺乏用于反思和控制的反馈机制。本文提出了一种面向知识图谱推理的主动自我反思框架，首次引入端到端训练方法，实现基于结构化图谱的迭代推理。在该框架内，模型利用特殊标记主动控制推理过程，实现按需检索和多维度、更细粒度的知识评估。所生成的推理路径……
tldr: 本文提出ArG框架，首次通过端到端训练方法，利用特殊标记让模型主动控制推理过程，实现知识图谱上的按需检索与多维度细粒度知识评估的迭代推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the ArG framework, which for the first time achieves iterative reasoning on knowledge graphs through end-to-end training, where the model uses special tokens to actively control the reasoning process, enabling on-demand retrieval and multi-dimensional, finer-grained knowledge evaluation.
